title: Implement Team section variant (team-cards)
description: Implement a Team section showing team member cards with photo, name, role, and optional bio.
acceptanceCriteria: Accepts `{ content: TeamContent, business: BusinessInfo }` props
Renders all team members with name, role, optional bio, optional photo
Fallback avatar shown when no photo is provided
Verify in browser with Playwright screenshot

steps.details: Headline + grid `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4`. Each card: circular avatar (imageUrl or initials fallback), name (h3), role (muted), bio (if present, truncated to 3 lines). Card background `--color-surface`.
Take Playwright screenshot. Confirm circular avatars, names, roles are visible.
